review_evidence: README describes an interactive Lean/Mathlib textbook designed to be read while working through examples and exercises in the repository.
The hydrated snapshot contains 89 Lean files and direct scan found more than 1,200 proposition declarations spanning sets/functions, structures, groups/rings, topology, analysis, and number theory.
Chapter and solution files contain substantial reusable theorem statements and proofs, for example the groups/rings and Gaussian-integers developments.
summary: Retain Mathematics in Lean as a large checked textbook corpus of examples, exercises, solutions, and mathematical formalizations.
